name: acf-whip
description: Workflow-native backlog automation. /task decomposes a scope into atomic, dependency-aware tasks; /go runs parallel specialists in isolated git worktrees (one per slug), reviews their work, and integrates accepted branches into the trunk via LP-CAS — looping until every task is accepted or blocked. Integration is a compare-and-swap of a single-parent candidate onto the live trunk with an in-tree ledger marker as the sole oracle: no cached snapshot, no rebase, convergent on rewritten/high-churn trunks. Concurrency-safe and self-healing via /whip-doctor.
